wifi.title: WiFi & Connectivity
wifi.qr.hint: Scan the QR code with your camera to connect automatically
wifi.streaming.title: Streaming Services
wifi.streaming.body: Netflix and Amazon Prime Video are installed on the TV. Please log in with your own account to enjoy. Please log out after use.
equipment.title: Equipment Guide
equipment.theater.title: 75" Theater & 5.1ch Surround
equipment.theater.steps:
• Turn on the TV with the remote control
  • The soundbar will automatically sync
  • Select an app from the Netflix button or Home screen
  • Adjust the volume with the volume buttons on the remote
equipment.teppan.title: BALMUDA The Plate Pro
equipment.teppan.steps:
• Place the plate on the main unit
  • Plug the power cord into an outlet
  • Adjust the temperature dial and preheat (approx. 3 min)
  • Cook your favorite ingredients and enjoy
  • After use, wipe with a damp cloth once the plate has cooled
equipment.coffee.title: Coffee Grinder & Drip
equipment.coffee.steps:
• Put beans in the grinder and grind to your preferred coarseness
  • Set a filter in the dripper and add the ground coffee
  • Pour a small amount of water at about 90°C and let it bloom for 30 seconds
  • Pour slowly in a circular motion
equipment.kitchen.title: Kitchen
equipment.kitchen.body: The kitchen is equipped with an IH stove, microwave, refrigerator, toaster, and basic cookware and tableware. Seasonings (salt, pepper, oil) are also provided.
equipment.deck.title: Wood Deck
equipment.deck.sub: Private deck with panoramic countryside views
equipment.deck.body: Feel free to use the deck chairs and table. At night, insects may be attracted to indoor lights — dim indoor lighting and use the deck lights instead.
equipment.bath.title: Bathroom & Amenities
equipment.bath.body: Bath towels, face towels, shampoo, conditioner, body soap, and a hair dryer are provided. Extra towels are in the cabinet under the vanity.
rules.title: House Rules
rules.nosmoking.title: No Smoking
rules.nosmoking.body: Smoking is prohibited on the entire premises, including the building and deck
rules.quiet.title: Quiet Hours
rules.quiet.body: Please keep noise levels down on the deck after 10 PM
rules.trash.title: Waste Separation
rules.trash.body: Bins in the kitchen are labeled. Please separate: burnable, bottles, cans, and PET bottles
rules.checkoutinfo.title: Before Check-out
rules.checkoutinfo.body: Please lightly rinse used dishes and leave them in the sink. Turn off A/C and lights, and lock all windows
rules.pets.title: No Pets
rules.pets.body: Pets are not allowed on the premises

access.title: Getting Here
access.address.title: Address
access.car.title: 🚗 By Car
access.car.list:
• From Osaka: Meishin Expressway → Kyoto-Higashi IC → Kosei Road → ~90 min
  • From Kyoto: Via Kosei Road → ~60 min
  • Parking: 2 spaces on premises (free)
access.train.title: 🚃 By Train
access.train.list:
• JR Kosei Line, get off at Shin-Asahi Station
  • Taxi from station: ~10 min
  • From Osaka Station to Shin-Asahi: ~90 min (JR Special Rapid → transfer at Omi-Imazu)
